title: Machine Bullshit: Characterizing the Emergent Disregard for Truth in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally grounded in epistemology and philosophy, specifically Harry Frankfurt's theory of 'bullshit,' to characterize the disregard for truth in AI. It evaluates LLMs using benchmarks like the UN Declaration of Human Rights and examines the ethical impact of AI alignment techniques on model truthfulness and deception.
